title: review: S2: compact the 12 builtin skills to the P6 structure with declared metadata (triggers, task classes, tools, required context, output contract), Level 0/1/2 renderings, and deterministic candidate selection; behaviour preserved, exposure unchanged
spec:
Program brief .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md P6, P8 (steps 1-4 only), P10, P26/P27 declarations (P37 stage 2). Depends on T-0863 (skills_registry: SkillRecord, sync, frontmatter keys roles/task_classes/triggers/tools/requires_context/output/security/repo). Facts: skills/<role>/<name>/SKILL.md, 12 files, bodies 450-3900 bytes; scripts under implement-spec, memory, repo-map, test-gap, trace-callers; references under memory and adversarial-review; tests/test_memory_skill.py and tests/test_hooks.py exercise the memory skill scripts; .claude/skills symlinks stay untouched (Stage 5 changes exposure).
Do:
1. Rewrite every SKILL.md body into the P6 structure with exactly these headings in this order: Trigger, Objective, Procedure, Tools, Evidence requirements, Output contract, Stop conditions, Failure/recovery. Keep every script invocation, path, guardrail sentence and output format the skill relies on today (the "behaviour" to preserve is: same scripts called with the same arguments, same output contract, same stop/commit rules); drop motivational prose, repeated explanation and generic instructions that the role prompts already carry (the executor lists in the result what was removed per skill). Fill the frontmatter with: roles, task_classes (attribution vocabulary: security, architectural, debugging, mechanical, unfamiliar, or "*"), triggers (deterministic keyword list plus optional scope globs, e.g. trace-callers: ["who calls", "callers", "readers", "what breaks", "impact"], test-gap: ["coverage", "untested", "missing tests"], repo-map: ["architecture", "layout", "where is"], adversarial-review: role-only, implement-spec: role-only), tools (Claude Code tool ids and script:<path>), requires_context (evidence source types from orchestrator/evidence.py SOURCE_TYPES, e.g. trace-callers: ["source_chunk", "graph_finding"]), output (one line), security (internal), repo (orchestrator or "*" for generic ones: trace-callers, test-gap, repo-map, adversarial-review, challenge, classify are generic; the planner skills, implement-spec and compact-memory are orchestrator-specific).
2. Measurement: docs/skill-intelligence/03-compaction.md table per skill: tokens before (l0/l2 from the registry sync at the parent commit) and after, what was removed, what was kept verbatim. Total l2 reduction must be reported; no minimum is imposed (correctness over size).
3. skills_registry.render(id, level) → Level 0: "- <id> — <description first sentence>"; Level 1: Trigger + Objective + Output contract sections; Level 2: the full compact body. `skills_registry.candidates(task, role, cfg=None)` (P8 steps 1-4, deterministic only): active-state skills whose roles match the role, whose task_classes include "*" or attribution.task_class(task), and whose triggers match the task title/spec/scope (keyword in title+spec lower-cased, or glob on scope); returns [{"id", "matched": [triggers], "level": 1}] ordered by number of matched triggers then id; role-only skills (no triggers) match on role alone. No Jev, no history (Stage 4/9).
4. Validation harness for P7 (minimal): tests/test_skills_compaction.py::test_every_skill_has_p6_headings_in_order, ::test_scripts_and_paths_referenced_before_are_referenced_after (compare the set of script paths and skills/ paths between git HEAD~ and the working tree per skill), ::test_frontmatter_declares_required_keys, ::test_l2_tokens_not_higher_than_before (per skill, using the registry), ::test_candidates_select_trace_callers_for_who_calls_task_and_not_for_docs_task, ::test_render_levels_nest (level 1 text is contained in level 2; level 0 is one line). Existing tests/test_memory_skill.py and tests/test_hooks.py must stay green (the memory skill's scripts and record/recall contracts are unchanged).
Constraints: skills/ content only plus the registry module and tests; do not touch .claude/skills, prompts, spawn.py or AGENTS.md. Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally. Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.
acceptance: tests/test_memory_skill.py and tests/test_hooks.py stay green; docs/skill-intelligence/03-compaction.md has the before/after table; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

result.summary: Verified against the packet's acceptance criteria: ran the full test suite via the same invocation tests-green.sh uses (python -m unittest discover -q tests) — 1123 tests pass, including all six tests/test_skills_compaction.py cases and the pre-existing test_hooks.py/test_memory_skill.py suites. Recomputed the before/after L2 token estimates independently (parent-commit skills vs working tree via skills_registry.sync) and they match docs/skill-intelligence/03-compaction.md exactly (3071→1541, -1530, 49.8%). Spot-checked frontmatter against the spec's exact vocabulary: task_classes values are all valid attribution classes, repo scoping matches the generic/orchestrator-specific split named in the spec, requires_context values are all valid orchestrator/evidence.py SOURCE_TYPES, and the three worked trigger-list examples (trace-callers, test-gap, repo-map) match verbatim. All 8 P6 headings appear in the specified order in every changed SKILL.md, and script/path references present before the change (verified via git show HEAD~) still appear after. Scope is respected — no changes outside skills/, orchestrator/skills_registry.py, tests/, and the new doc. No defects found.
